description: Explore the Italian public data available on DoveVannoINostriSoldi. Discover datasets, filters and coverage, then query public spending, revenue, benefits and other indicators with their sources, periods, units and limitations. The service is read-only: it does not make payments or change data. Each data snapshot has its own reporting period and update date. Online sources may be temporarily unavailable. Differences or unusual values do not prove waste, fraud or individual responsibility.
